hero.label: A learning assistant for SQL
hero.title: Learn SQL with three AI agents
hero.text: The Teacher explains topics from your course materials, the Examiner gives tasks and checks queries on a real database, and the Mentor tracks your progress and suggests what to do next.

agents.label: Three agents
agents.title: One question, three roles
agents.question: Student question
agents.questionText: How is WHERE different from HAVING?

steps.orchestrator: Every message goes to the orchestrator first. It looks at the question and the session state and decides which agent is needed.
steps.teacher: Explains the topic from the course notes and shows which material the answer comes from.
steps.examiner: Gives an SQL task and runs the query in a sandbox: the result is compared with a reference, not guessed by the model.
steps.mentor: Keeps a model of what the student knows and decides what comes next: review the topic, give a hint or move on.

sandbox.label: SQL sandbox
sandbox.title: The database checks your query, not a guess
sandbox.text: Your SQL runs on the course database in an isolated sandbox, and the result is compared with a reference.
sandbox.task: List each student name with every grade they have.

topics.label: Five course topics
topics.title: From your first SELECT to subqueries

items.title: SELECT and WHERE
items.text: Pick the columns you need and keep the rows that match a condition.

items.title: Sorting and LIMIT
items.text: Order the result and take only the first rows.

items.title: Aggregates and GROUP BY
items.text: Count, sum and average values for each group.

items.title: JOIN
items.text: Combine rows of two tables by a shared column.

items.title: Subqueries
items.text: Use the result of one query inside another.

progress.label: Progress by topic
progress.title: See what you have mastered
progress.text: The Mentor estimates how well you know each topic and shows it on a scale.
